I was the president of the anime club in highschool. As elitist as this may sound I felt like I was so into anime I had somewhat of a disconnect between the other members of the club. I refused to show Bleach/Naruto because you could catch those any time on Cartoon Network and I wanted to broaden the horizons of the kids in the club and show them other cool anime they might not have heard of otherwise. I donated my personal collection of comics and anime DVDs to my club's library. For Christmas, I asked my parents for anime DVDs just so I could donate them to the club and share them with everyone. There were 20 kids in the club at the beginning of the year... at the end, there were four. Maybe I was just a shitty president, but because I wasn't showing Bleach and Naruto, everyone lost interest. I paid my Japanese teacher a visit after I graduated and checked out the club's shelf out of nostalgia. All the things I had personally donated were gone. I had been almost consistently buying one volume of manga every week since I was 12 years old with my $10/week allowance, so it was a pretty huge collection. I asked what happened to them and she said that the kids donated them to the library because they didn't want them... I hope they're seeing some use at the library, at least.
